name: 健身工厂
title: Muscle Factory
summary: A dystopian factory reflecting on the pursuit of an ideal body.

sections.title: Inspiration
sections.text: In modern society, people's excessive pursuit of fitness and body shape, as well as the influence of fitness bloggers showcasing their ideal body shape on young people on social media, lead to psychological stress and physical damage.
sections.zh: 项目关注现代社会对健身和体型的过度追求，以及社交媒体上健身博主展示的理想身材如何给年轻人带来心理压力与身体损伤。

sections.title: Concept
sections.text: Through personal fitness experiences and interviews, explore the negative effects of excessive fitness on the body and mind, reflect on the extreme pursuit of fitness and appearance in modern society, construct a dystopian future world, and showcase the absurd scene of people being enslaved by fitness and aesthetic standards.
sections.zh: 通过个人健身经历与访谈，探索过度健身对身心的负面影响。项目构建了一个反乌托邦的未来世界，呈现人被健身与审美标准支配的荒诞场景，反思对体型和外貌的极端追求。

sections.title: Visual outcome
sections.text: Designed a series of posters and scene illustrations, with the future factory as the background, comparing the human body to a mechanized "fitness machine", expressing the absurdity of excessive fitness through exaggerated muscles and mechanical elements, and triggering audience thinking about healthy lifestyles.
sections.zh: 以未来工厂为背景创作系列海报和场景插画，将身体比作机械化的“健身机器”。夸张的肌肉与机械元素呈现过度健身的荒诞，引导观众思考健康的生活方式。

name: 离不了
title: Prolonged Difficult Progress of Divorce in China
summary: Making the complexity of divorce procedures visible through a foldable publication.

sections.title: Inspiration
sections.text: The complexity of divorce in Chinese society, especially the social discussions and tragic cases triggered by the divorce cooling off policy, such as domestic violence victims being killed during the cooling off period.
sections.zh: 项目源于对中国社会离婚程序复杂性的关注，尤其是离婚冷静期引发的社会讨论，以及家暴受害者在冷静期内遇害等悲剧案例。

sections.title: Concept
sections.text: By analyzing the divorce process, legal policies, and news cases, explore the impact of divorce cooling off periods on different families, especially the unfairness towards victims of domestic violence and economically disadvantaged families.
sections.zh: 通过分析离婚流程、法律政策与新闻案例，探索离婚冷静期对不同家庭的影响，重点关注家暴受害者与经济弱势家庭面对的不公平处境。

sections.title: Visual outcome
sections.text: A foldable brochure was designed to present the complexity of the divorce process in the form of a book, including the cooling off period policy, the steps of divorce litigation, court trial cases, etc. Through visual means, readers can quickly understand the details and issues of the divorce procedure.
sections.zh: 设计一本可折叠的手册，以书籍形式呈现离婚程序的复杂性，包含冷静期政策、离婚诉讼步骤与庭审案例。通过视觉编排，帮助读者理解程序的细节及其中的问题。

name: 新保龄运动
title: New Bowling Campaign
summary: A fictional bowling brand questioning the commercialisation of child influencers.

sections.title: Inspiration
sections.text: The emergence of a large number of children's bloggers on short video platforms, as well as the negative phenomena caused by this, such as children being overly commercialized, their privacy being violated, and forming a "performative personality".
sections.zh: 短视频平台上大量儿童博主的出现，引出了儿童被过度商业化、隐私遭侵犯以及形成“表演型人格”等问题，成为项目的出发点。

sections.title: Concept
sections.text: Using "New Bowling" as a virtual brand, combining bowling elements and the image of a children's blogger, using exaggerated techniques to satirize the phenomenon of children being manipulated in the adult business world, and to raise social attention to the protection of minors.
sections.zh: 以“新保龄”为虚拟品牌，将保龄球元素与儿童博主的形象结合，以夸张的手法讽刺儿童在成人商业世界中被操控的现象，引发对未成年人保护的关注。

sections.title: Visual outcome
sections.text: Designed a series of posters and brand logos, using bowling pins as elements to compare children's bloggers to bowling balls being hit, expressing the "commodification" of children's bloggers through commercial labels and slogans, and enhancing visual impact with broken font styles.
sections.zh: 创作系列海报与品牌标志，以保龄球及球瓶建立儿童博主被操控的隐喻，通过商业标签和口号呈现其“商品化”，并以破碎的字体强化视觉冲击。

name: 血液涅槃
title: Blood Nirvana
summary: An interactive installation exploring blood donation, recovery and participation.

sections.title: Inspiration
sections.text: The problem of difficulty in blood donation worldwide, including insufficient blood donation numbers, difficulties in blood preservation and transportation, supply-demand imbalance, and the current situation where the rights and interests of blood donors are difficult to protect under China's free blood policy.
sections.zh: 项目关注献血人数不足、血液保存和运输困难、供需失衡等问题，也关注中国无偿献血政策下献血者权益保障的处境。

sections.title: Concept
sections.text: By conducting research on public awareness and attitudes towards blood donation, analyzing the reasons for low blood donation rates, designing a visual device to promote blood donation knowledge, eliminate misunderstandings, and stimulate public enthusiasm for blood donation.
sections.zh: 通过研究公众对献血的认知与态度，分析献血率较低的原因，设计视觉装置以传播献血知识、消除误解，并激发公众参与的意愿。

sections.title: Visual outcome
sections.text: An interactive art installation was designed to showcase the process of blood donation, blood composition data and recovery status, as well as interactive links connecting digital screens and blood donation bags, allowing the audience to intuitively experience the meaning and process of blood donation and enhance their sense of participation.
sections.zh: 设计互动艺术装置，呈现献血流程、血液成分数据与恢复状态，并连接数字屏幕和献血袋，让观众直观体验献血的意义与过程，增强参与感。
